<module id="LIFObuffer">
    <description>A Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) buffer for temporary data storage. This 4-bit wide buffer can hold up to 4 entries, allowing for push and pop operations controlled by read/write (RW) signals.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="dataIn" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit input data to be pushed onto the buffer.</input>
        <input id="RW">Read/Write control signal (1 for read, 0 for write).</input>
        <input id="EN">Enable signal to activate buffer operations.</input>
        <input id="Rst">Active high reset signal to initialize the buffer.</input>
        <input id="Clk">Clock signal for synchronous operations.</input>
        <output id="EMPTY">Flag indicating whether the buffer is empty.</output>
        <output id="FULL">Flag indicating whether the buffer is full.</output>
        <output id="dataOut" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit output data retrieved from the buffer.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        Regsiter SP;
        Wire[3:0] stack_mem[3:0];
        Reg[3:0] stack_mem_reg[3:0];
        Reg[3:0] dataOut;
        
        //Stack Memory Initialization
        Integer i;
        Always @(posedge Clk or posedge Rst) begin
            if(Rst) begin
                SP <= 4'd4;
                for(i = 0; i < 4; i=i+1) begin
                    stack_mem[i] <= 4'h0;
                end
            end
            else if(EN == 1'b1)begin
                case({RW})
                    1'b0:begin//Write Operation
                        if(!FULL)begin
                            stack_mem[SP-1] <= dataIn;
                            SP <= SP - 1;
                        end
                    end
                    
                    1'b1:begin//Read Operation
                        if(!EMPTY)begin
                            dataOut <= stack_mem[SP];
                            stack_mem[SP] <= 4'h0;
                            SP <= SP + 1;
                        end
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
        
        Assign EMPTY = (SP == 4'd4)? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
        Assign FULL = (SP == 4'd0)? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
        
        Assign stack_mem[0] = stack_mem_reg[0];
        Assign stack_mem[1] = stack_mem_reg[1];
        Assign stack_mem[2] = stack_mem_reg[2];
        Assign stack_mem[3] = stack_mem_reg[3];
        
        Always@(*) begin
            stack_mem_reg[0] = stack_mem[0];
            stack_mem_reg[1] = stack_mem[1];
            stack_mem_reg[2] = stack_mem[2];
            stack_mem_reg[3] = stack_mem[3];
            
            if((!FULL && !EMPTY) || RW == 1'b1) begin
                stack_mem_reg[SP] = dataIn;
            end
        end
        
        //Assigning DataOut
        Always@(posedge Clk) begin
            if(EN == 1'b1) begin
                if(RW == 1'b1) begin
                    dataOut = stack_mem_reg[SP];
                end
            end
        end
        
        
    </implementation>
    
</module>
